notes.finding_float_roundtrip: serde_json in the workspace is built without float_roundtrip: f64 values with 17 significant digits drift by 1 ulp through package JSON (observed: 0.9599999785423279 reopened as 0.959999978542328). interop-fig avoids it (f32 values enter as their shortest decimal, computed values kept to 12 significant digits). Other importers writing f32-derived or computed f64 values into Folio documents/records may drift on reopen; folio/package own the fix (float_roundtrip feature or a canonical float rule). Lead check suggested.
